scope: Offline aggregate-only screening of the locally acquired IGAR V2 paired Rating/VADER source data before anonymous public backup

source_dataset.title: IGAR: Indonesian Government App Review Dataset

method.analysis_kind: Programmatic numeric-shape and nearby-language context screening; no verification of any person, identifier ownership, number validity, or contactability
method.expanded_numeric_rule: Boundary-delimited runs containing 8–24 numeric digits with optional spaces, periods, parentheses or hyphens
method.phone_shape: Indonesian mobile-like numeric shape; simple ascending/repeated dummy sequences and explicit example/dummy wording separately screened
method.nik_shape: 16 numeric digits plus coarse Indonesian province-code and date-of-birth component plausibility; not an identity verification or complete NIK validator
limitations: Numeric candidates include non-personal dates, error codes, versions, reference numbers and amounts.
A nearby ownership word does not establish that a number belongs to the reviewer.
The mobile-like candidate is a plausible disclosure, not a verified active or personally owned phone number.
No detected bank/address patterns or structurally plausible NIK is not evidence of absence.
Screening can miss obfuscated numbers, names, private addresses, health or financial disclosures and other identifying context.
No consent or permission for independent anonymous mirroring of third-party personal disclosures was established.
A source copyright license does not itself resolve personal-data consent or a backup host privacy requirement.

previous_screen.qualification: Earlier screening used a different numeric-pattern rule. Counts are preserved as that screen result, not directly revised or comparable to the expanded rule.

release_decision.derived_feature_privacy_description: No review handles, raw content, translation, or exact review timestamps. Includes pseudonymous record IDs, review month, source app/rating/label features and nontext flags.
release_decision.recommendation: Do not anonymously mirror exact IGAR source free text. Keep the nontext derivative and original source locators/hashes so original licensed data remains obtainable from the original publisher.
